text.description_html:
First Impressions 5 Inch "C" Shower Door Handles

These ultra sleek 5" high shower door pulls are hand made by the master craftsmen at First Impressions.

This "C" Door Pull is available in other sizes and finishes, Contact Us for more information.

Impeccably hand crafted from high grade 3/8" thick solid brass in your choice of 3 high quality, long lasting finish choices. Made in the USA.

Specifications: of First Impressions "C" Door Pull

  • Height: 5"
  • Width: 2-1/2"
  • Projection: 2"
  • Mounting Holes: 4" Center to Center
  • Material: Solid Brass

Note: These shower door handles are handmade in the USA when you order it—allowing it to be custom designed to fit your specific door application, including other sizes and finishes. Unfortunately, because of the made-to-order nature of the door handle, it is Not Returnable. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

Packaged with 2 door pull handles and includes the hardware for back to back mounting on 1/4" to 1/2" thick glass shower doors.

*Sold as a Pair (2 Pulls, Back to Back mounted)
